name: Charger
desc: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Improved Dash: when you take the Dash action, your Speed increases by 10 feet for that action. Charge Attack: once per turn, after moving at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a target, a melee hit as part of the Attack action deals an extra 1d8 damage or pushes the target up to 10 feet.
